decision_reason: M1169 may only run the M1168 target-margin microgrid diagnostic and compare against M1161/M1166. It cannot rerun mining, rerun outcome gate, train actor weights, run PPO, promote, use private holdout, change actor inputs, convert a surface, or claim full surface pass.
failure_criteria: comparison to M1161 and M1166 remains ambiguous
mining, outcome rerun, actor training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, conversion, or actor-input change starts
forbidden_shortcuts: do not claim full surface pass from the microgrid diagnostic
hypothesis: Restoring fine target margins including 0.0005 will recover at least the M1161 old sensitive pair that M1166 missed; if it does not reveal new source-diverse pairs, same-shape relocation remains exhausted.

blocked_by: M1168 designs the exact microgrid command
invalidates: full same-shape relocation expansion before target-grid diagnosis
PPO before refreshed wrong-history surface evidence
parent_objective: run the fine target-margin microgrid diagnostic designed in M1168

public_gates: M1169 may run only the M1168 microgrid command
M1169 must reuse the existing M1161 outcome CSV
M1169 must restore fine target margins including 0.0005
M1169 must keep body offsets fixed at 0.0
M1169 must not rerun outcome gate
M1169 must not train actor weights
M1169 must not use private holdout
M1169 must not convert a surface
success_criteria: old M1161 pair recovery is reported
new physical-pair recovery beyond the two M1161 pairs is reported
comparison to M1161 and M1166 is explicit
no mining, outcome rerun, actor training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, conversion, or actor-input change occurs
